summary: The coworkers who keep their jobs work less hard when they think the employer chose the layoff to protect profit.
realLife: A lab experiment reported by the London School of Economics found remaining workers produced less after their employer chose to dismiss a colleague, and the drop vanished when the firing was forced.
sources: London School of Economics Business Review, The hidden cost of downsizing: https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/businessreview/?p=11976
inGame: job record for remaining coworkers; a coworker's job-ended event can lower a mood the job record reads.

turns.summary: The employer explains the closing of a shift and the staff pitch in.
turns.writesBack: mood: steady; tie to boss closer

turns.summary: The staff do just the minimum for weeks.
turns.writesBack: mood: sour; tie to boss colder
